articles.summary: First Financial Bank employees across the State of Texas will come together for the Bank's 11 th annual Day of Service on October 12, 2026. For the second consecutive year, the Bank will also join the Texas Bankers Association (TBA) for the Texas Banks Community Day of Service, a statewide initiative that brings Texas financial institutions together to serve and support their local communities. On Monday, October 12 th , 2026, over 1,100 First Financial employees across the State will spend their holiday volunteering with local nonprofits, schools, and service organizations. From food banks to neighborhood cleanups, the goal is simple: to make Texas stronger—together. "Community service is at the heart of who we are," said David Bailey, President and CEO of First Financial Bankshares. "We are so proud of our employees who use their day off to make a meaningful difference. That speaks volumes of our commitment to serving our communities." The Texas Banks Community Day of Service
articles.title: FIRST FINANCIAL BANK TO PARTICIPATE IN STATEWIDE DAY OF SERVICE
